React Router is the standard routing library for React applications. It enables you to: Create multiple pages in your single-page application Handle URL parameters and query strings Manage browser history and navigation Create nested routes and layouts Implement protected routes for authentication Without a router, your React application would be limited to a single page with no way to navigate between different views.
